messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Figure çaptions not appearing or appearing in the wrong place
parts:
That is a bug due to the evaluate package, which has been fixed in the
development version. What you can do is to either wait for the CRAN
release (not sure when), or install the devel versions:

library(devtools)
install_github('evaluate', 'hadley')
install_github('knitr', 'yihui')

Regards,
Yihui

I do not know what is wrong with LaTeX, but you can always download
the package and install manually (without building the vignettes):

wget https://github.com/yihui/knitr/archive/master.tar.gz
tar xzf knitr-master.tar.gz
R CMD build knitr-master --no-vignettes
R CMD INSTALL knitr_*.*.*.tar.gz
